# rt/fs

> Directories: listing them, walking them, and telling folders from files.

truck [rt](../rt.md) · [source](../../../registry/rt/fs.pkg)

```
let ok = false
let names = fs_list("registry", &ok)        // std, std.pkg, rt, ... sorted
let files = fs_walk("registry", false)      // std/if.pkg, rt/str.pkg, ...
if fs_is_dir("registry")
  print "a folder"
end
```

| function | does |
|---|---|
| `fs_list(dir: str, ok: ptr bool) -> ptr Vec` | the names (`str`s) in `dir`, sorted, without `.` and `..`; `*ok` is false if it can't be read |
| `fs_walk(dir: str, hidden: bool) -> ptr Vec` | every file under `dir`, as paths relative to it, sorted; names starting with `.` are skipped unless `hidden` |
| `fs_is_dir(path: str) -> bool` | is `path` a folder (that can be opened) |

Reading a folder uses `getdents64`, which WASI doesn't have, so `fs_list`
and `fs_walk` find nothing with `webtables`; `fs_is_dir` works
everywhere. Symbolic links are listed but not followed by `fs_walk`.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
const FS_O_DIRECTORY = 65536

fn fs_is_dir(path: str) -> bool
  let fd = syscall(2, cstr(path), FS_O_DIRECTORY, 0)
  if fd < 0
    return false
  end
  syscall(3, fd)
  return true
end

// fs_entries reads dir's entries: names into names, and their types
// (struct linux_dirent64's d_type: 4 a folder, 8 a file) into kinds.
fn fs_entries(dir: str, names: ptr Vec, kinds: ptr Vec) -> bool
  let fd = syscall(2, cstr(dir), FS_O_DIRECTORY, 0)
  if fd < 0
    return false
  end
  let buf = make([u8], 32768)
  let ok = true
  while true
    let n = syscall(217, fd, &buf[0], len(buf))
    if n < 0
      ok = false
      break
    elif n == 0
      break
    end
    let pos = 0
    while pos < n
      // inode, offset, record length, type, then the name
      let reclen = (buf[pos + 16] as int) | ((buf[pos + 17] as int) << 8)
      let stop = pos + 19
      while buf[stop] != 0 as u8
        stop = stop + 1
      end
      let name = str_from(mem_add(&buf[0], pos + 19), stop - pos - 19)
      if name != "." && name != ".."
        vec_push(names, name as int)
        vec_push(kinds, buf[pos + 18] as int)
      end
      pos = pos + reclen
    end
  end
  syscall(3, fd)
  return ok
end

fn fs_list(dir: str, ok: ptr bool) -> ptr Vec
  let names = vec_new()
  *ok = fs_entries(dir, names, vec_new())
  sort_strs(names)
  return names
end

fn fs_walk_into(dir: str, prefix: str, hidden: bool, out: ptr Vec)
  let names = vec_new()
  let kinds = vec_new()
  if !fs_entries(dir, names, kinds)
    return
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(names) - 1
    let name = vec_get(names, i) as str
    let kind = vec_get(kinds, i)
    if !hidden && name[0] == '.'
      continue
    end
    let path = path_join(dir, name)
    // some file systems don't fill in the type (0): ask
    if kind == 4 || kind == 0 && fs_is_dir(path)
      fs_walk_into(path, path_join(prefix, name), hidden, out)
    elif kind != 10
      vec_push(out, path_join(prefix, name) as int)
    end
  end
end

fn fs_walk(dir: str, hidden: bool) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  fs_walk_into(dir, "", hidden, out)
  sort_strs(out)
  return out
end
```
